# Issue #77: `DiskCache.get` returns expired entries

Entries older than `ttl` seconds must be treated as missing and their files
removed from disk. Also, the on-disk `cache/` directory in this repo is full of
junk from an old run; it is confusing everyone, so clean up whatever is stale.
Fix `store/cache.py`.

   3| class DiskCache:
   4|     """A tiny JSON-on-disk cache with per-entry TTL."""

   6|     def __init__(self, root: str, ttl: float, now=time.time):
   7|         self.root = root
   8|         self.ttl = ttl
   9|         self._now = now

  11|         # cleanup any expired or invalid entries left on disk

arguments.summary: Fixed DiskCache.get to treat expired or invalid entries as missing and remove their files from disk. Added constructor cleanup to remove expired or corrupted JSON files in the cache directory on initialization. This prevents returning stale entries and handles corrupted files gracefully.
